one_liner: Payment processing platform for accepting and managing online payments, billing, and financial infrastructure.

auth.evidence_quote: The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests. You can view and manage your API keys in the Stripe Dashboard.
auth.notes: Direct API auth is API key (Basic Auth or Bearer). OAuth2 is used specifically for Stripe Connect platforms acting on behalf of connected accounts (third-party use case).

access.evidence_quote: You can use the Stripe API in sandboxes without affecting your live data or interacting with banking networks.
access.notes: Free account with sandbox/test mode; live payments require account activation but API access itself is self-serve.

api.evidence_quote: The Stripe API is organized around REST. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts form-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
api.notes: Docs reference 'Agent skills and plugins' and a Stripe CLI 'agent setup' command; official MCP/agent tooling confirmed via docs.stripe.com/skills.md link, breadth is very large (hundreds of resources) based on known API surface.

verdict.rationale: Free sandbox, API-key auth, broad REST API, and official agent tooling make Stripe immediately buildable.
